steps.title: Water intake
steps.general_explanation: Water is withdrawn to supply cooling.
unknowns: Exact intake geometry, flow and organism capture are not provided by monthly temperatures.
steps.confirmed_for_system: Historical registry codes O, ON report this cooling family. This is not a current pipe map.

steps.title: Heat transfer
steps.general_explanation: Cooling water takes up heat while steam is cooled back into liquid water.
unknowns: Monthly inlet/outlet averages do not show instantaneous heat flow or the path of one droplet.
steps.confirmed_for_system: Historical registry codes O, ON report this cooling family. This is not a current pipe map.

steps.title: Discharge and mixing
steps.general_explanation: Water returns to a receiving water body, where further mixing depends on local conditions.
unknowns: No downstream temperature map, mixing distance or safety conclusion is available.
steps.confirmed_for_system: Historical registry codes O, ON report this cooling family. This is not a current pipe map.

limitations: The drawing does not track an actual droplet or depict the real pipe layout.
No plume shape, travel time, population effect or safety verdict is calculated.
Historical cooling codes are not a current engineering inspection; mixed/unknown codes remain educational.
journey.ai_role: Ridge estimates the temperature difference across a cooling system for a completed month. Environmental reports use reviewed sources and rules, not a trained environmental-safety model.
